vulnerabilities.description: This is a buffer overflow: while processing a crafted input, `parse_header` read or wrote past the end of a memory buffer. Out-of-bounds access can corrupt memory, leak data, crash the program, and in some cases be steered into running attacker code. Triggered by the attached test input (`testcase.bin`).
vulnerabilities.name: Heap-based Buffer Overflow in parse_header
vulnerabilities.solution: Bounds-check the index/length before the access at `src/parse.c:42` (`parse_header`): validate it against the buffer size before reading or writing.
